_about: Clip library for the automatic editor. 'categories': topic labels + script keywords. 'clips': one record per footage file — enabled (use in edits), cats (topics), dull (seconds never to use), manual (tagged by hand; hand-tagged clips also teach the auto-tagger), reason (why disabled). New files are tagged by autotag.py.

stories.springlock: The trailer's slide-out ramp extension had its old spring lock broken off under the beam end. The shop ground away the broken lock and the end stop (clips 5, 6, 7), welded the end stop back on (clip 4), then welded in a new ring-pull spring lock and tested the slide-out (clips 1, 2, 3). This order is inferred from the clips, since the file order is not the work order.
stories.rampwidening: A loading ramp that was too narrow for the tires was widened by fitting square-tube side extensions, which were then welded on, as the shop describes it. Judged by the visible condition, the order looks like: ramp with chalk width marks (clips 1-2), extension on with fresh weld heat marks (clips 3-5), then grey and black finished-looking ramp (clips 6-7).
stories.sleevereplacement: The job was replacing a damaged square-tube sleeve and spring lock assembly on a car-hauler trailer ramp cylinder, starting with the old rusty, worn sleeve and its latch hook. The old assembly was removed, leaving a bare ground hole in the side bracket. A new tube was made up on the bench with a red clevis plate welded on, then fitted, and finally the cylinder and coiled spring lock were back on the new sleeve.
stories.rampextensionfabrication: The shop cut flat-bar and plate pieces and welded hinge barrels onto perforated plates on a bench. They then fitted and welded the hinged extension flap onto the end of the trailer deck, and the clips end with walkarounds of the finished flap and deck. The clip numbers are taken as the work order, 1 to 13.
stories.crossmemberrepair: A rusty, pinholed trailer crossmember beside the hydraulic cylinders was cut out and lay loose on the ground, with the grinder and rubber mat nearby. A new bare steel bar was then fitted across the frame, and the last clip shows a bright red crossmember in place.
